patterns.note: Sections frequently feature full-bleed, high-resolution imagery of vehicles, often with dark overlays to ensure text readability.
Headings use a custom, bold, and often uppercase sans-serif font ('LamboType') for a strong brand presence, contrasted with a more legible sans-serif for body text and labels.
The site employs a high-contrast dark theme, predominantly black and dark grey, with vibrant accent colors (blue and orange/red) used sparingly for calls-to-action and interactive elements.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, maintaining persistent access to site navigation.
Product sections like 'MODELS' and 'CONFIGURE YOUR TEMERARIO' utilize interactive carousels with clear navigation arrows and pagination dots to showcase different vehicle models and configurations.
Key content sections are clearly delineated with large, bold headings and often feature a single dominant vehicle image or a carousel, creating distinct visual blocks.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation bar maintains brand presence and access to key links throughout the scroll, transitioning from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid background.
Full-width hero and product sections use large, high-quality background images or potential video backgrounds, with a dark gradient overlay to ensure text contrast and maintain a luxurious aesthetic.
Product display sections implement full-width carousels, likely using a library like Swiper, to allow users to browse multiple items with clear navigation controls and smooth transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, often uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, uppercase labels and standard body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate the overall design, with subtle rounding applied only to interactive elements like input fields and some buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, emphasizing large imagery and clear separation between content blocks, particularly in hero and section headers, with tighter spacing in news grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, high-contrast dark theme combined with vibrant, almost neon-like accent colors for CTAs and interactive elements creates a luxurious and performance-oriented feel. This dramatic backdrop effectively highlights the sleek car designs and reinforces the brand's premium identity.
